Pantheon

Support Weird but works

Poke Support Pantheon

How to play this build

Poke with Spear (Q) at max range — below 15% target health it's a guaranteed crit. Start the all-in with Aegis of Zeonia (W) to stun so your ADC finishes. The global ult (Grand Skyfall) lets you help other lanes.

Skill order

Max priority:

Q Lanza Cometa → W Asalto Égida → E Bloqueo de Corazón

The ultimate (R) is always leveled at 6, 11 and 16.

Level 123456789101112131415161718
Q QQQQQ
W WWWWW
E EEEEE
R RRR
Why this order
Spear (Q) for ranged poke (guaranteed crit under 15% HP); W second for the all-in stun.

Items and what they do

  1. Sightstone Support item granting free ward charges to control vision.
  2. The Black Cleaver AD and health; your hits stack armor shred on the target.
  3. Youmuu's Ghostblade AD, crit and CDR; active gives a burst of attack speed and move speed to assassinate.
  4. Mercury's Treads Boots with MR and tenacity (reduced CC duration).
  5. Randuin's Omen Health and armor; active AoE slow that also cuts attackers' attack speed.

Masteries: how they work

In Season 3 you have up to 30 points (at level 30) to split across three trees: Offense (damage), Defense (durability) and Utility (mana, cooldown reduction and mobility). The notation 21/0/9 means 21 points in Offense, 0 in Defense and 9 in Utility.

Masteries
21/9/0 — Offense
Why this page
21/9/0 boosts poke and burst with some lane durability.
